```{r}
df_raw <- df_raw %>%
  mutate(
    bmi = (bio_weight / (bio_height^2)) * 703
  )

df_raw <- df_raw %>%
  mutate(
    vrf_obesity = if_else(bmi > 30, 1L, 0L, missing = 0L),

    vrf_diabetes = if_else(
      health_medical_type_1_diabetes == 1 |
      health_medical_type_2_diabetes == 1,
      1L, 0L, missing = 0L
    ),

    vrf_smoking = if_else(
      health_medical_smoking == 1,
      1L, 0L, missing = 0L
    ),

    vrf_hypertension = if_else(
      health_medical_hypertension == 1,
      1L, 0L, missing = 0L
    ),

    vrf_cholesterol = if_else(
      cholesterol > 200,
      1L, 0L, missing = 0L
    )
  )

df_raw <- df_raw %>%
  mutate(
    vascular_risk_count =
      vrf_obesity +
      vrf_diabetes +
      vrf_smoking +
      vrf_hypertension +
      vrf_cholesterol,

    vascular_risk_cat = case_when(
      vascular_risk_count == 0 ~ "0",
      vascular_risk_count == 1 ~ "1",
      vascular_risk_count >= 2 ~ "2+",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    vascular_risk_cat = factor(
      vascular_risk_cat,
      levels = c("0", "1", "2+")
    )
  )

df_raw <- df_raw %>%
  mutate(
    hispanic_latino_bin = if_else(
      hispanic_latino == "Yes",
      1L,
      0L
    ),
    hispanic_latino_bin = factor(
      hispanic_latino_bin,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("No / Not Hispanic", "Hispanic")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# ========================================================================
# PAN / MindCrowd wearable + DWI analysis
# Updated for NEW column names + education/race recodes + site-z outcomes
# Copy/paste ready
# ========================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(broom)
library(car)
library(performance)
library(ggpubr)
library(GGally)
library(gtsummary)
library(gt)
library(purrr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Prep: factors + derived variables + education/race recodes
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
df_raw <- df_raw %>%
  mutate(
    site = factor(site),

    # Normalized cortical volume: cortical gray matter volume / eTIV
    cortexvol_norm_etiv =
      coree_chen_anat_measures_freesurfer_aseg_cortexvol /
      coree_chen_anat_measures_freesurfer_aseg_etiv,

    extra_neurite_fraction_cortex =
      pmax(
        1 -
          coree_chen_dwi_measures_noddi_gm_gmcort_fit_ndi_cerebral_cortex -
          coree_chen_dwi_measures_noddi_gm_gmcort_fit_fwf_cerebral_cortex,
        0
      ),

    edu_cat = case_when(
      highest_education_level_completed %in% c(
        "Some High School",
        "High School Diploma (Baccalaureate)"
      ) ~ 0,
      highest_education_level_completed == "Some College (Some University)" ~ 1,
      highest_education_level_completed == "College Degree (University Graduate)" ~ 2,
      highest_education_level_completed ==
        "Post Graduate Degree (Masters or Doctorate)" ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    race_cat = case_when(
      race == "Black or African American" ~ 1,
      race == "White" ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    edu_cat = factor(
      edu_cat,
      levels = 0:3,
      labels = c(
        "HS or less",
        "Some college",
        "College degree",
        "Post-graduate"
      )
    ),
    race_cat = factor(
      race_cat,
      levels = c(0, 1, 2),
      labels = c(
        "Other / Not White or Black",
        "Black",
        "White"
      )
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Create within-site z-scored outcomes
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
by_site_outcomes <- c(
  "coree_chen_dwi_measures_noddi_gm_gmcort_fit_fwf_cerebral_cortex",
  "coree_chen_dwi_measures_noddi_gm_gmcort_fit_ndi_cerebral_cortex",
  "coree_chen_dwi_measures_noddi_gm_gmcort_fit_odi_cerebral_cortex",
  "coree_chen_dwi_measures_tensor_gm_gmcort_desc_adc_cerebral_cortex",
  "cortexvol_norm_etiv"
  #"noddi_wm_wmintra_desc_icvf_cerebral_white_matter",
  #"noddi_wm_wmintra_desc_isovf_cerebral_white_matter",
  #"noddi_wm_wmintra_desc_od_cerebral_white_matter",
  #"tensor_wm_wmintra_desc_adc_cerebral_white_matter",
  #"tensor_wm_wmintra_desc_fa_cerebral_white_matter"
)

df_raw <- df_raw %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(by_site_outcomes),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)),
      .names = "{.col}_z_site"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

outcomes_y <- paste0(by_site_outcomes, "_z_site")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1B) Create globally z-scored outcomes for sensitivity analyses
#     These are NOT standardized within site
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------

df_raw <- df_raw %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(by_site_outcomes),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)),
      .names = "{.col}_z_global"
    )
  )

outcomes_global_z <- paste0(by_site_outcomes, "_z_global")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Define predictors and covariates
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
predictors <- c(
  "mvpa_min",
  "mean_daily_10hr_steps"
)

covariates <- c(
  "age_hml",
  "sex_hml",
  "edu_cat",
  "race_cat",
  "apoe_e4_carrier",
  "days_of_recording",
  "site",
  "hispanic_latino_hml",
  "vascular_risk_cat"
  #"gmcort_perfusion_calib_cerebral_cortex",
  #"freesurfer_leftdk_meanthickness",
  #"freesurfer_rightdk_meanthickness"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Build analysis dataset
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
df_analysis <- df_raw %>%
  filter(
    days_of_recording >= 6,
    days_of_recording <= 31,
    daily_monitoring_hr >= 20
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sex_hml = factor(sex_hml),
    site = factor(site),

    apoe_e4_carrier = case_when(
      coreg_huentelman_apoe4_apoe_status %in% c("e3e4", "e4e4", "e2e4") ~ 1,
      coreg_huentelman_apoe4_apoe_status %in% c("e2e2", "e2e3", "e3e3") ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    mvpa_min = mean_moderate_intensity_duration_minute +
      mean_vigorous_intensity_duration_minute,

    cortexvol_norm_etiv =
      coree_chen_anat_measures_freesurfer_aseg_cortexvol /
      coree_chen_anat_measures_freesurfer_aseg_etiv
  ) %>%
  filter(
    mean_daily_10hr_steps > 100,
    mean_daily_10hr_steps <= 25000,
    mvpa_min >= 0,
    #moca_total > 23,
    coree_chen_dwi_measures_tensor_gm_gmcort_desc_adc_cerebral_cortex < 0.0016,
    is.finite(cortexvol_norm_etiv),
    coree_chen_anat_measures_freesurfer_aseg_etiv > 0,
    coree_chen_anat_measures_freesurfer_aseg_cortexvol > 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # skew-robust sensitivity versions
    mvpa_min_log = log1p(mvpa_min),
    mean_daily_10hr_steps_log = log1p(mean_daily_10hr_steps)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Standardize predictors globally
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
df_analysis <- df_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(predictors),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)),
      .names = "{.col}_z"
    ),
    across(
      c(mvpa_min_log, mean_daily_10hr_steps_log),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)),
      .names = "{.col}_z"
    )
  )

predictors_z <- c("mvpa_min_z", "mean_daily_10hr_steps_z")
predictors_log_z <- c("mvpa_min_log_z", "mean_daily_10hr_steps_log_z")
outcomes_z <- outcomes_y

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Model runner
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------

library(lmtest)
library(sandwich)

run_lm <- function(outcome, predictors_z, covariates, data, robust_type = "HC3") {
  f <- as.formula(
    paste(outcome, "~", paste(c(predictors_z, covariates), collapse = " + "))
  )

  lm_fit <- lm(f, data = data)

  # conventional OLS output
  out_tbl_ols <- broom::tidy(lm_fit, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      outcome = outcome,
      se_type = "OLS"
    )

  # robust HC3 output
  vcov_rob <- sandwich::vcovHC(lm_fit, type = robust_type)
  ct_rob   <- lmtest::coeftest(lm_fit, vcov. = vcov_rob)

  out_tbl_rob <- broom::tidy(ct_rob) %>%
    rename(
      estimate = estimate,
      std.error = std.error,
      statistic = statistic,
      p.value = p.value
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      conf.low = estimate - qt(0.975, df = df.residual(lm_fit)) * std.error,
      conf.high = estimate + qt(0.975, df = df.residual(lm_fit)) * std.error,
      outcome = outcome,
      se_type = robust_type
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, conf.low, conf.high, outcome, se_type)

  vif_tbl <- car::vif(lm_fit) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    rename(vif = 1) %>%
    mutate(outcome = outcome)

  list(
    model = lm_fit,
    tidy_ols = out_tbl_ols,
    tidy_robust = out_tbl_rob,
    vif = vif_tbl
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# FINAL analytic sample used for regression models and Table 1
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
analysis_vars <- unique(c(
  outcomes_z,          # within-site z outcomes
  outcomes_global_z,   # global z outcomes for sensitivity analysis
  by_site_outcomes,
  predictors,

  predictors_log_z,

  "daily_monitoring_hr",

))

get_cor_results <- function(data, vars, method = "pearson") {
  combn(vars, 2, simplify = FALSE) %>%
    purrr::map_dfr(function(v) {
      tt <- suppressWarnings(
        cor.test(
          data[[v[1]]],
          data[[v[2]]],
          method = method,
          exact = FALSE
        )
      )

      out <- broom::tidy(tt) %>%
        mutate(
          var1 = v[1],
          var2 = v[2],
          comparison = paste(v[1], "vs", v[2]),
          method = method,
          .before = 1
        )

      # make sure CI columns exist even when cor.test/broom does not return them
      if (!"conf.low" %in% names(out)) out$conf.low <- NA_real_
      if (!"conf.high" %in% names(out)) out$conf.high <- NA_real_

      out
    }) %>%
    mutate(
      p_fdr = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      method, comparison, var1, var2,
      estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value, p_fdr
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------

panel_cor <- function(data, mapping, digits = 3, prefix = "Corr: ", method = "pearson", ...) {
  x <- eval_data_col(data, mapping$x)
  y <- eval_data_col(data, mapping$y)

  test <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x, y, method = method))
  r <- unname(test$estimate)
  p <- test$p.value

  stars <- case_when(
    p < .001 ~ "***",
    p < .01  ~ "**",
    p < .05  ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )

  label <- paste0(prefix, "\n", format(round(r, digits), nsmall = digits), stars)

  ggally_text(
    label = label,
    mapping = aes(),
    xP = 0.5,
    yP = 0.5,
    size = 8,
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
    theme_void()
}

p_pairs <- GGally::ggpairs(

  lower = list(continuous = wrap("smooth_loess", alpha = 0.5, size = 0.2)),
  diag  = list(continuous = "densityDiag")
) +

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

# Outcome names
outcome_md <- "coree_chen_dwi_measures_tensor_gm_gmcort_desc_adc_cerebral_cortex_z_site"

outcome_fwf <- "coree_chen_dwi_measures_noddi_gm_gmcort_fit_fwf_cerebral_cortex_z_site"

# Reusable prediction-grid function
make_pred_grid <- function(data, mvpa_var = "mvpa_min_z", n = 150) {
  
  mvpa_seq <- seq(
    min(data[[mvpa_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
    max(data[[mvpa_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = n
  )
  
  # Numeric covariates: mean
  typical <- data %>%
    summarise(
      across(
        everything(),
        ~ if (is.numeric(.x)) mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE) else NA
      )
    )
  
  nd <- typical[rep(1, n), , drop = FALSE]
  nd[[mvpa_var]] <- mvpa_seq
  
  # Factor covariates: modal/most common level
  factor_vars <- names(data)[sapply(data, is.factor)]
  
  for (v in factor_vars) {
    modal_level <- names(which.max(table(data[[v]])))
    nd[[v]] <- factor(modal_level, levels = levels(data[[v]]))
  }
  
  nd
}

# Reusable plot function
plot_mvpa_prediction <- function(
    outcome,
    model_list,
    data,
    y_label,
    plot_title = ""
) {
  
  m <- model_list[[outcome]]$model
  
  nd <- make_pred_grid(
    data = data,
    mvpa_var = "mvpa_min_z",
    n = 150
  )
  
  pred <- predict(
    m,
    newdata = nd,
    interval = "confidence",
    level = 0.95
  )
  
  pred_df <- bind_cols(
    nd %>% dplyr::select(mvpa_min_z),
    as_tibble(pred)
  )
  
  ggplot(pred_df, aes(x = mvpa_min_z, y = fit)) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
      alpha = 0.20,
      linewidth = 0
    ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
    labs(
      x = "MVPA, standardized",
      y = y_label,
      title = plot_title
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12)
}

# MD plot

  model_list = fits,
  data = df_pr,
  y_label = "Cortical MD, z-scored within site",

library(ggplot2)

library(tidyr)

# Outcomes to plot

outcome_fwf <- "coree_chen_dwi_measures_noddi_gm_gmcort_fit_fwf_cerebral_cortex_z_site"

# Covariates and other PA predictor to adjust for
rhs_no_mvpa <- c(
  setdiff(predictors_z, "mvpa_min_z"),
  covariates
)

# Function to create partial regression dataframe
make_partial_df <- function(data, outcome, predictor = "mvpa_min_z", covariates_adjust) {
  
  f_y <- as.formula(
    paste(outcome, "~", paste(covariates_adjust, collapse = " + "))
  )
  
  f_x <- as.formula(
    paste(predictor, "~", paste(covariates_adjust, collapse = " + "))
  )
  
  vars_needed <- unique(c(outcome, predictor, covariates_adjust))
  
  df_partial <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(vars_needed)) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na() %>%
    dplyr::filter(if_all(where(is.numeric), is.finite))
  
  ry <- resid(lm(f_y, data = df_partial))
  rx <- resid(lm(f_x, data = df_partial))
  
  tibble(
    mvpa_partial = rx,
    outcome_partial = ry
  )
}

# Function to plot partial regression in your desired visual style
plot_partial_mvpa <- function(partial_df, y_label) {
  
  ggplot(partial_df, aes(x = mvpa_partial, y = outcome_partial)) +
    geom_point(
      color = "black",
      alpha = 0.55,
      size = 2.2
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      se = TRUE,
      color = "#2F55F5",
      fill = "gray70",
      linewidth = 1.3
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Moderate to Vigorous Physical Activity",
      y = y_label
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 16)
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9B) Sensitivity: globally z-scored outcomes with PA × site interactions
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------

run_lm_site_int <- function(outcome, covariates, data, robust_type = "HC3") {

  # Remove site from covariates because it is already included in the interaction terms
  covars_no_site <- setdiff(covariates, "site")

  f <- as.formula(
    paste(
      outcome, "~",
      paste(
        c(
          "mvpa_min_z * site",
          "mean_daily_10hr_steps_z * site",
          covars_no_site
        ),
        collapse = " + "
      )
    )
  )

  lm_fit <- lm(f, data = data)

  vcov_rob <- sandwich::vcovHC(lm_fit, type = robust_type)
  ct_rob <- lmtest::coeftest(lm_fit, vcov. = vcov_rob)

  tidy_rob <- broom::tidy(ct_rob) %>%
    mutate(
      conf.low = estimate - qt(0.975, df = df.residual(lm_fit)) * std.error,
      conf.high = estimate + qt(0.975, df = df.residual(lm_fit)) * std.error,
      outcome = outcome,
      se_type = robust_type
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value,
      conf.low, conf.high, outcome, se_type
    )

  list(
    model = lm_fit,
    tidy_robust = tidy_rob
  )
}

fits_site_int_global_z <- purrr::map(
  outcomes_global_z,
  ~ run_lm_site_int(
    outcome    = .x,
    covariates = covariates,
    data       = df_pr,
    robust_type = "HC3"
  )
)
```

```{r}
check_influence <- function(model, outcome_name) {
  n <- nobs(model)
  p <- length(coef(model))

  cooks_d <- cooks.distance(model)
  hat_vals <- hatvalues(model)
  dfb <- dfbetas(model)

  # if only one coefficient, dfbetas can come back as a vector
  if (is.null(dim(dfb))) {
    max_dfb <- abs(dfb)
  } else {
    max_dfb <- apply(abs(dfb), 1, max, na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  infl_df <- tibble(
    obs = seq_len(n),
    cooks_d = cooks_d,
    hat = hat_vals,
    max_dfbeta = max_dfb,
    cooks_flag = cooks_d > (4 / n),
    leverage_flag = hat_vals > (2 * p / n),
    dfb_flag = max_dfb > (2 / sqrt(n)),
    outcome = outcome_name
  )

  infl_df
}

influence_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
  fits,
  ~ check_influence(.x$model, outcome_name = deparse(formula(.x$model)[[2]]))
)

influence_flags <- influence_results %>%
  filter(cooks_flag | leverage_flag | dfb_flag)

influence_flags
```

```{r}
# Libraries ---------------------------------------------------------------
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)

library(broom)
library(car)          # VIF
library(performance)  # optional diagnostics
library(ggpubr)



# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create within-site z-scored outcomes (create these BEFORE selecting them)
# NOTE: here we are creating *_z_site for all outcomes you want to model
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
by_site_outcomes <- c(
  "coree_chen_dwi_measures_noddi_gm_gmcort_fit_fwf_cerebral_cortex",
  "coree_chen_dwi_measures_noddi_gm_gmcort_fit_ndi_cerebral_cortex",
  "coree_chen_dwi_measures_noddi_gm_gmcort_fit_odi_cerebral_cortex",
  "coree_chen_dwi_measures_tensor_gm_gmcort_desc_adc_cerebral_cortex"
)

df_raw <- df_raw %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(by_site_outcomes),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)),
      .names = "{.col}_z_site"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outcomes (use the site-z versions)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
noddi_outcomes <- paste0(by_site_outcomes, "_z_site")

# Predictors --------------------------------------------------------------
predictors <- c(
  "mvpa_min",
  "mean_daily_10hr_steps",
  "mean_total_sleep_time_hr",
  "mean_sleep_efficiency_percentage"
)

# Covariates --------------------------------------------------------------
# IMPORTANT: If your outcomes are already z-scored within site, including "site"
# is often redundant. Two options:
#   (A) keep site (most conservative / reviewer-safe)
#   (B) drop site to avoid redundancy
covariates <- c(
  "age_hml",
  "sex_hml",
  "edu_yrs_hml",
  "apoe_e4_carrier",
  "days_of_recording",
  "site",  # keep for now; see note above
  "mean_resting_heart_rate_bpm",
  "coree_chen_anat_measures_freesurfer_aseg_etiv"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Analysis dataset
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
df_analysis <- df_raw %>%
  filter(
    days_of_recording >= 5,
    daily_monitoring_hr >= 20
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sex_hml = factor(sex_hml),
    site    = factor(site),
    apoe_e4_carrier = case_when(
      apoe_status %in% c("e3e4", "e4e4", "e2e4") ~ 1,
      apoe_status %in% c("e2e2", "e2e3", "e3e3") ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    # MVPA minutes
    mvpa_min = mean_moderate_intensity_duration_minute +
      mean_vigorous_intensity_duration_minute
  ) %>%
  filter(
    mean_daily_10hr_steps > 0,
    mean_daily_10hr_steps <= 25000,
    mean_total_sleep_time_hr > 0,
    mean_total_sleep_time_hr < 12,
    mvpa_min >= 0,
    tensor_gm_gmcort_desc_adc_cerebral_cortex < 0.0015
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model runner
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
run_lm <- function(outcome, predictors_z, covariates, data) {
  f <- as.formula(
    paste(outcome, "~", paste(c(predictors_z, covariates), collapse = " + "))
  )

  lm_fit <- lm(f, data = data)

  out_tbl <- broom::tidy(lm_fit, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(outcome = outcome)

  vif_tbl <- car::vif(lm_fit) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    rename(vif = 1) %>%
    mutate(outcome = outcome)

  list(model = lm_fit, tidy = out_tbl, vif = vif_tbl)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Standardize predictors (global z)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
df_analysis <- df_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(predictors),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)),
      .names = "{.col}_z"
    )
  )

predictors_z     <- paste0(predictors, "_z")
noddi_outcomes_z <- noddi_outcomes  # already standardized within-site

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fit all models (Y already site-z; X z-scored globally)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
fits <- purrr::map(
  noddi_outcomes_z,
  ~ run_lm(
    outcome      = .x,
    predictors_z = predictors_z,
    covariates   = covariates,
    data         = df_analysis
  )
)
names(fits) <- noddi_outcomes_z

# Collect results ---------------------------------------------------------
all_tidy <- purrr::map_dfr(fits, "tidy")
all_vif  <- purrr::map_dfr(fits, "vif")

results_main <- all_tidy %>%
  filter(term %in% predictors_z) %>%
  select(outcome, term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"))

results_main

# VIF checks --------------------------------------------------------------
vif_summary <- all_vif %>%
  arrange(desc(vif))
vif_summary

vif_flags <- all_vif %>%
  group_by(outcome) %>%
  summarise(
    max_vif = max(vif, na.rm = TRUE),
    any_vif_gt5  = any(vif > 5, na.rm = TRUE),
    any_vif_gt10 = any(vif > 10, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_vif))
vif_flags

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example prediction plot for cortical ADC site-z outcome
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
outcome <- "tensor_gm_gmcort_desc_adc_cerebral_cortex_z_site"
m <- fits[[outcome]]$model

make_pred_grid <- function(data, mvpa_var = "mvpa_min_z", n = 100) {
  mvpa_seq <- seq(min(data[[mvpa_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
                  max(data[[mvpa_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
                  length.out = n)

  typical <- data %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), ~{
      if (is.numeric(.x)) mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE) else NA
    }))

  nd <- typical[rep(1, n), , drop = FALSE]
  nd[[mvpa_var]] <- mvpa_seq

  factor_vars <- names(data)[sapply(data, is.factor)]
  for (v in factor_vars) {
    nd[[v]] <- levels(data[[v]])[which.max(table(data[[v]]))]
    nd[[v]] <- factor(nd[[v]], levels = levels(data[[v]]))
  }

  nd
}

nd <- make_pred_grid(df_analysis, mvpa_var = "mvpa_min_z", n = 150)

pred <- predict(m, newdata = nd, interval = "confidence", level = 0.95)
pred_df <- bind_cols(
  nd %>% select(mvpa_min_z),

)

ggplot(pred_df, aes(x = mvpa_min_z, y = fit)) +

    y = "Cortical ADC (z-scored within site)",
    title = "Adjusted association of MVPA with cortical diffusion"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Partial regression plot (use same outcome as model!)
# NOTE: use the same outcome you modeled (site-z). Also residualize using the
#       same RHS set as in your model (minus mvpa).
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
rhs_no_mvpa <- c(
  setdiff(predictors_z, "mvpa_min_z"),

)

f_y <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", paste(rhs_no_mvpa, collapse = " + ")))
f_x <- as.formula(paste("mvpa_min_z ~", paste(rhs_no_mvpa, collapse = " + ")))

ry <- resid(lm(f_y, data = df_analysis))
rx <- resid(lm(f_x, data = df_analysis))

partial_df <- tibble(
  mvpa_partial    = rx,

ggplot(partial_df, aes(x = mvpa_partial, y = outcome_partial)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  labs(

    y = "Cortical ADC (partial, adjusted)"
```
